title: Make catalog and quality UI show exact evidence status
summary: Round 2 after verifier return: StrokePiG relabelled Legacy only with the exact native time-series pilot and the unreviewed 46-recording run; README job-directory row rewritten; GT24 label carries the withdrawn ankle fix; MBLUE receipts marked unreviewed; test count no longer hand-written. Round 1: Catalog rows now carry a linked evidence status and count labels naming the file counted; downloads are labelled legacy. Quality page gains a Status by dataset section (8 cards), removes all historical queued claims (now prepared/stopped per the 27 Oct refresh), corrects the superseded GT23 moment-unit claim, and summarizes software tests by purpose with passed/failed/not-run counts and a dated unassessed count. Previews state their legacy source file, download-name relation, task coverage, equal-subject mean and SD, and pooling. converted_datasets/README.md rewritten without cleaned/tested claims.
